items.q: What will I learn in the social media marketing course?
items.a: You plan content, create Reels, grow communities and run paid campaigns on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn, across six modules.

items.q: Which platforms does the course cover?
items.a: Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube, with a focus on how each platform works.

items.q: How much is the social media marketing course fee?
items.a: Fill in the enquiry form or WhatsApp +91 84619 58162. Our team will share the fee, EMI options and batch dates.

items.q: Can college students or working professionals join?
items.a: Yes. Ask our team for the batch timings that suit you.
Yes. Every learner who completes the program gets a completion certificate, verifiable on our Verify Certificate page.

items.q: Will I have a portfolio of social media work?
items.a: Yes. Because learning is based on live briefs, you finish with real work to show employers and clients.

items.q: Which jobs can I get after this course?
items.a: Social Media Executive, Content Marketer, Community Manager and Paid Social Executive roles, or freelance social media management.

items.q: Can I manage my own business pages afterwards?
items.a: Yes. You will know how to plan a month of content, track results and run a small Meta ads campaign.
